column1: # Armoury: named map villages (layout v7: villages spread over the whole land of their district - from layout v6, the same villages and people per district). One row = one map village
# scene_xml_crc: 146201570
# (cluster of settlements of the district of village_id). road_deg = road / river / coast direction 0..180; order = default burn order
# (0 = nearest to the game village by road); front_deg = model front (local +Y) yaw; half_len/half_wid = footprint.
# kind = PLACE (bridge / ford / crossroad / road / river / lake / coast / field), unchanged; model (v4, last column) = PICTURE:
# village / mill (water mill) / windmill / farm / granary / fishing - which group of buildings the view shows.
# v5 (tools/wioski-v5/v5_uklad.py from arm_map_villages_v4.tsv): 20% fewer villages - the one whose nearest neighbour stands
# closest goes first (every district keeps at least one); settlements vary by place kind and a factor from the uid (6..36,
# 1500..9000 people); order / toward_village / neighbors / level recomputed by the v4 generator rules; the rest unchanged.
# v6 (tools/wioski-v6/v6_przysiolki.py from arm_map_villages_v5.tsv): 215 villages of the densest clusters moved to empty land of the same
# district as small hamlets (shepherds, goatherds, drovers, swineherds, woodcutters, charcoal burners, trappers, hunters, fishers); the freed
# settlements went to the other villages of the district (district sum = v5). hamlet = occupation; ks_* = land of the hamlet point for KS
# (start craft, terrain, place, picture, distances to sea / river / mountains) - the same world table as arm_ks_land.tsv; '-' = not a hamlet.
# v5_order / v5_x / v5_y / v5_settlements = the same row in layout v5 (every row): a save of layout v5 maps by uid from this file alone.
# v7 (tools/wioski-v7/v7_uklad.py from arm_map_villages_v6.tsv): minimum distance village-village and village-game village 12.26 (2 x v6 6.13); 1484 villages
# of crowded clusters moved to the empty land of their district (water, fields, forest edges, hills); people of the moved villages of a district
# shared among them by their new place (district sum = v6). ks_* = land of the point for KS for every moved village (and v6 hamlets); hamlet = occupation.
# v6_order / v6_x / v6_y / v6_settlements = the same row in layout v6 (every row): a save of layout v6 maps by uid from this file alone.
